value.body: Central and state public-sector undertakings (PSUs) recruit qualified CAs and CMAs as finance executives — often titled Executive Trainee, Officer or Assistant Manager (Finance). The work covers accounts, costing, budgeting, taxation, audit coordination and financial reporting under PSU rules.

items.label: Typical qualification
items.note: Some notices also accept an MBA (Finance)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Qualify as a Chartered Accountant (ICAI) or Cost and Management Accountant (Institute of Cost Accountants of India); many notices accept either. PSUs advertise on their own websites with their own age limits and steps — shortlisting, a written or computer-based test, group discussion and/or interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are irregular and spread across many companies, so tracking individual PSU notices matters.
Pay follows each company's own pay scale, stated in its notification.
Postings can be at plants, project sites or regional offices, with transfers.
Experience in a PSU finance team can lead to senior finance and audit roles in the public sector.
